speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development for each year in the past five years, what is the mean and median salaries of Child Protection Officers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The Parliamentary Question is to ask for the mean and median salaries of our CPOs for each year, for the past five years.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I would be grateful if we can have the data so that we could see whether there is an increase in the salaries of our officers over the last few years.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Second, I understand there is a review on the administrative workload of our CPOs.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, could I ask when that review is expected to be completed?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Third, if I may, Sir, I know Senior Parliamentary Secretary Eric Chua has been doing his level best to try and support and help our CPOs, but could I ask again on the manpower issue and, perhaps, in the last few months, how many new CPOs have we hired?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I share as well as appreciate his concern for our CPOs.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: So, what I have answered in my main reply, was to demonstrate that there is a whole range of officers with different levels of proficiencies.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: That is to the first point that he made.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: On the second point about review that was mentioned earlier, I think what Mr Louis Ng was trying to allude to was, what kind of support, more broadly, are we offering to our CPOs.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: We understand that, as I have mentioned before in a previous Sitting, in a reply to Mr Ng as well, we should look at the entire stream of both recruitment as well as retention; and in the retention phase, the training that we can provide to each CPO as well as the support, in terms of the wellness services that we can provide to each officer.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: If I can take this opportunity to reiterate some of the initiatives that we have put in place.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I know Mr Louis Ng is also very concerned about workload.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I think this is a point that he has mentioned a number of times in this Chamber.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I do not see an endpoint in sight, because it has got to be an ongoing process.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: With regard to the last point – if we can just ask the Member to repeat the last point that he made.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I do not have the numbers on hand, but what the Member is concerned about is caseload.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: We are trying to bring that number down by making sure that we can recruit as well as retain good CPOs.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: Mr Louis Ng would, perhaps, be heartened to know that for newer CPOs who join us in the service, the supervisors would take a very caring approach to make sure that they do not immediately go to the level of workload and the level of complexity, in terms of the cases that they handle.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: Again, I thank the Member for his concern for our CPOs.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: The Ministry of Social and Family Development share them as well and we want to help in every way possible for them to succeed as well.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I think we have agreed that 40 is too high.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: My concern is that more CPOs have contacted me to say they have a higher caseload than 40 and that is what is worrying.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: I know they are not doing this for money, but I think salary it is an important factor.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Could I ask, at least, whether the median and mean salaries of the starting salaries of our new CPOs have increased over the last few years?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: Again, whether there is a concrete plan to increase the manpower at our Child Protective Service (CPS)?

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: I think there is a plan for us to recruit more officers.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: In terms of remuneration, again, I share that this is one of several components that we need to look at, in order to make sure that we can better support our officers in child protection so that they can succeed in their work.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: There may be some officers who are more experienced, who are more senior, in terms of years in service, who are handling more than this average number.

speaker: Mr Eric Chua
text: But I think those will be fewer and farther between.
